description: Long tables stretch beneath a vaulted ceiling hung with the tattered banners of wizardly orders that no longer exist, mostly for reasons involving spontaneous combustion. The air smells of high tea and faint ozone.

items.name: a dented silver teapot
items.description: It's still faintly warm, and occasionally mutters.

doorways.description: Back out to the front gate.
A pair of tall doors, heavily scorched around the edges.
A swinging door lets out the smell of dinner.
